query: What calibration and validation protocol is recommended for InVEST water-yield/runoff models when stream gauge data and soil-depth/k information are sparse or uneven?

response.query: What calibration and validation protocol is recommended for InVEST water-yield/runoff models when stream gauge data and soil-depth/k information are sparse or uneven?
response.answer: For sparse or uneven data, use regional calibration with local stream gauges and expert-derived soil-depth/k values in InVEST water-yield/runoff models. Sensitivity analysis and cross-validation are recommended to ensure model reliability.

results.title: Assessing climate and land use impacts on surface water ...
results.content: This study examined the combined effects of temporal and spatial climate variability and land use/land cover (LULC) changes on surface water yield and availability in the Gilgel Gibe watershed, Ethiopia, from 1993 to 2023. Prior studies using the InVEST model have assessed the watershed water production capacity and explored the effects of climate and land-use changes on water yield25, 2024–2048. The primary objectives of this study were as follows: (1) to evaluate temporal variations in surface water yield under climate variability, (2) to analyze the spatial distribution of LULC change and its direct impact on water availability, and (3) to develop predictive models that integrate climate and land use projections to forecast future water yield fluctuations.
